5779.title: Download attribution bypasses privacy signals
5779.rootCauseOneLine: Client campaign carry and server analytics assembly do not check GPC, preserving click IDs in saved attribution, download links and captured URLs.

prReviews.topFinding: Targets the implicated owners; PR code and tests were not run.

5779.proposedFix: Filter gclid at the browser and endpoint boundaries when the corresponding privacy signal is enabled, including saved values and captured URLs; preserve other campaigns.
5779.caveats: Tests and evidence are embedded in the HTML per reports repository policy. Repeated by the same agent on two clean main checkouts. jsdom and stubbed outbound HTTP, not a production browser or external analytics receipt. No duplicate PR because #5780 is open.
